Liam / team — I pulled the token export and attached a sanitized CSV (usage_report_q1.csv) with per-hour totals. Quick findings: 

- Baseline committed tokens (contracted): 120M tokens/month
- Feb actual: 151.3M (spike concentrated Feb 20 03:00–06:00 PST)
- Mar actual: 128.9M
- Overage calculation (per contract): 0.000032 USD per excess token beyond commitment

Preliminary overage = (151.3M - 120M) * $0.000032 = $992.96 for Feb alone; combined Feb+Mar excess totals to $3,984.64 (see spreadsheet). The vast majority (>75%) of the variance is tied to the migration window Liam mentioned.

I also attached a breakdown workbook (proposed_settlement_breakdown.xlsx) with line-by-line token math and a suggested one-time line item. Let me know if you want raw logs — I can share a limited window.

Action items:
- Liam: confirm the migration timeframe and whether those requests were part of normal customer activity or an engineering migration/test.
- Marissa/Karthik: decide on goodwill credit vs full invoiced overage.
